acceptedOriginals.caption: I took this photo of Nolan Ryan of the Houston Astros at Atlanta-Fulton County Stadium on June 28, 1983. In the background is left-fielder Jose Cruz, who Ryan once said was his favorite teammate. The Astros won the game 4-3. Ryan pitched for 8 innings and gave up only 2 hits, both of them homers.
